limits: Only three named crater polygon identities were secure enough to use independently. Prospero, Ferdinand, Francisco and Trinculo were not forced to nearby fresh-impact polygons.
The graticule fit includes an affine shear/rotation to preserve the actual displayed page; it is not an exact circular screenshot assumption.
The four-class page fit has 5958 correlated edge samples, median 1.35 pixels, 90th percentile 2.37 pixels, maximum 19.49 pixels. Its all-sample RMS is not independent scientific accuracy.
Named polygon centroids differ from Gazetteer crater centres by the reported degree-scale amounts, which include map/source/control differences.
Preserve original polygon coverage and withhold northern hemisphere, polygon holes and unresolved layer conflicts. Do not extend geology into unmapped surface.
The bogus archived Earth/WGS84 Orthographic CRS is retained as source metadata and is not applied to Miranda coordinates. Source polygon Z is not terrain elevation.
No runtime, bake or rendered-globe qualification has yet been run.
